services.title: Facebook Page Recovery
services.cardSummary: Restoring ownership and administrator access to a compromised Facebook Page.
services.summary: Recovering ownership and administrator access to Facebook Pages that have been compromised, hijacked, or lost.
services.problem: Facebook Pages are frequently targeted for takeover, which can lock the legitimate administrator out while the page's audience and reputation remain at risk.
services.approach: I investigate how the compromise happened, work through Meta's review and verification processes, and focus on restoring legitimate administrator access and securing the page once control is regained.
whoFor: Page owners whose administrator access was removed or changed
Businesses and creators who can no longer manage a Page they own
Organizations whose Page was taken over by a former team member or an attacker

process.title: Tell me what happened
process.text: Use the contact form to describe the problem, when it started, and what you have already tried.

process.title: I review the evidence
process.text: I check the Page's admin history, the proof of ownership you have, and any Meta notices you received.

process.title: You get a written plan
process.text: You receive a summary of the routes open for your case, what each one needs, and what I recommend.

process.title: We work the case and secure it
process.text: We work through Meta's review steps, then tighten admin roles and two-factor settings once access is restored.

send: The Page name and URL
The personal account that is, or was, an admin, if you know it
When you first noticed the problem, and any Meta notices or emails you received
Any proof of ownership you have, such as business documents, past admin invitations, or screenshots
limitations: Recovery depends on Meta's review, which I cannot control or speed up
A Page with unresolved policy restrictions can be harder to recover
I can only work to restore access that you can show is legitimately yours

meta.title: Facebook Page Recovery | Atikul Islam Rabbi
meta.description: Help recovering a hacked, hijacked or lost Facebook Page. Structured review of ownership evidence and Meta's recovery routes. No guaranteed outcomes.

services.title: Facebook Account Recovery
services.cardSummary: Regaining access to a hacked or locked personal Facebook account.
services.summary: Recovering compromised or inaccessible personal Facebook accounts.
services.problem: A hacked or disabled personal Facebook account can cut off years of connections, business communication, and linked assets such as Pages and ad accounts.
services.approach: I assess how the account was compromised, guide the ownership-verification process, and work to restore legitimate access while closing the security gap that allowed the compromise.
whoFor: People locked out of a personal account after a takeover
Account holders whose account was disabled and who need to appeal
Admins of Pages or ad accounts whose access runs through a personal profile

process.title: Tell me what happened
process.text: Describe the lockout, the email or phone number on the account, and any messages you have received from Facebook.

process.title: I assess the account
process.text: I look at how access was lost and which verification routes are realistically open.

process.title: You get a written plan
process.text: You receive the steps, what each one needs from you, and which steps only Meta can complete.

process.title: We restore access and secure it
process.text: We work through the verification steps, then review passwords, recovery contacts, and two-factor settings.

send: The email address or phone number linked to the account
Any recovery messages or notices you received from Facebook
When the lockout started, and what changed just before it
The names of any Pages or ad accounts you manage from this profile
limitations: Meta decides whether ownership is verified. I cannot submit identity checks on your behalf
If the email and phone number on the account are no longer accessible, recovery can take longer
I do not work around platform controls

meta.title: Facebook Account Recovery | Atikul Islam Rabbi
meta.description: Help regaining access to a hacked or locked personal Facebook account, with a clear plan for what Meta must verify. No guaranteed outcomes.

services.approach: I investigate the compromise, guide the account-ownership verification process with Meta, and work toward restoring legitimate access, then reduce the chance of a repeat.
whoFor: Creators and brands whose audience and content history are at risk
Businesses whose Instagram account is linked to a Meta Business Manager
Account owners locked out after a takeover or a change of email or phone number

process.title: Tell me what happened
process.text: Share the username, the contact details on the account, and what you noticed first.

process.title: I assess the account
process.text: I check how access was lost and whether the account is linked to a Page or Business Manager.

process.text: You receive the verification steps, what each needs from you, and which steps only Meta can complete.

process.title: We restore access and secure it
process.text: We work through the verification steps, then review login alerts, recovery contacts, and two-factor settings.

send: The Instagram username
The email address or phone number linked to the account
Any login alerts or emails you received
Whether the account is linked to a Facebook Page or Business Manager
limitations: Recovery depends on Meta's ownership verification, which is outside my control
Accounts with earlier policy violations may face additional review

meta.title: Instagram Account Recovery | Atikul Islam Rabbi
meta.description: Help recovering a hacked or locked Instagram account, including creator and business accounts. Evidence-based steps and honest limits. No guaranteed outcomes.

services.title: Meta Business Manager Recovery
services.cardSummary: Restoring control of a hacked or restricted Business Manager and the assets attached to it.
services.summary: Recovering hacked or restricted Meta Business Managers, including their linked Pages, ad accounts, and assets.
services.problem: A compromised or restricted Business Manager can affect every asset connected to it at once: Pages, ad accounts, and team access. This is one of the more complex recovery scenarios.
services.approach: I investigate the scope of the compromise or restriction, work through Meta's Business Manager review and verification processes, and focus on restoring legitimate administrator control across all affected assets.
whoFor: Businesses and agencies whose Business Manager was hacked or restricted
Teams that lost administrator access after a staff change
Advertisers whose ad accounts are attached to a restricted Business Manager

process.title: Tell me what happened
process.text: Share the Business Manager ID, the restriction or takeover, and the date it started.

process.title: I map every linked asset
process.text: We list the Pages, ad accounts, and admins attached, so nothing is missed in the plan.

process.title: You get a written plan
process.text: You receive the route for each asset, what Meta needs, and which steps depend on Meta's review.

process.title: We restore control and secure it
process.text: We work through the review steps, then reset admin roles and remove access that should not be there.

send: The Business Manager ID, from Business Settings
The names of the Pages and ad accounts attached to it
The current admin list, and any admins that were removed or added recently
Any restriction or review notices from Meta, with dates
limitations: Meta's review timelines are outside my control
A restriction on one linked asset can affect the others
Business documents must be genuine and current for verification

meta.title: Meta Business Manager Recovery | Atikul Islam Rabbi
meta.description: Help restoring control of a hacked or restricted Meta Business Manager and its linked Pages and ad accounts. Clear limits, no guaranteed outcomes.

services.title: Business Verification Guidance
services.cardSummary: Preparing a business for Meta Business Manager verification and clearing what blocks it.
services.summary: Guiding businesses through Meta Business Manager verification, including resolving restrictions that block the process.
services.problem: Meta's business verification can be blocked by earlier restrictions, unclear requirements, or incomplete documents, which leaves legitimate businesses stuck.
services.approach: I review the current state of the Business Manager, resolve any restrictions standing in the way, and guide the business through preparing for and completing Meta's verification.
whoFor: Businesses stuck at the verification step
Agencies verifying a client's Business Manager
Businesses whose verification was rejected and who need to prepare again

process.title: Tell me where you are stuck
process.text: Share the verification message you see and the documents you plan to submit.

process.title: I review the Business Manager
process.text: I check for restrictions and inconsistencies that could block verification.

process.title: You get a written plan
process.text: You receive the restrictions to clear, the documents needed, and the order to submit them.

process.title: We submit and follow up
process.text: We submit once the setup is ready, then track Meta's response and handle any follow-up request.

send: The legal business name and registration details
The business website and domain, if any
The business documents you plan to submit
Any earlier verification rejection messages
limitations: I cannot create or alter business documents
Verification decisions are made by Meta, not by me
Some restrictions take time to clear

meta.title: Business Verification Guidance | Atikul Islam Rabbi
meta.description: Guidance for Meta Business Manager verification: clearing restrictions, preparing documents, and submitting correctly. Approval is decided by Meta.

services.title: Admin Dispute Resolution
services.cardSummary: Resolving disputes over who legitimately administers a Page or Business Manager.
services.summary: Resolving disputes over Page or Business Manager administrator access and asset ownership.
services.problem: Disputes over who legitimately administers a Page or Business Manager can leave assets frozen or contested, especially after a change in team, a former partner keeping access, or a takeover attempt.
services.approach: I review the ownership and administrative history of the asset, help establish legitimate ownership through Meta's dispute and verification channels, and work toward a resolution that restores proper control.
whoFor: Businesses where a former partner or employee still controls assets
Teams with conflicting admin claims after a takeover
Owners who need to re-establish control of a Page or Business Manager

process.title: Tell me who is involved
process.text: Describe the asset, the people involved, and the history you know about.

process.title: I review the history
process.text: I review the admin and ownership record to find what can be shown and by whom.

process.title: You get a written plan
process.text: You receive the evidence to gather, the Meta route to use, and the likely next steps.

process.title: We submit and follow the case
process.text: We submit through Meta's channels and track each response until a decision is made.

send: The asset name and ID
The admin history you know about, and who was involved
Documents that show ownership or authority
Any communication with the other party or with Meta about the dispute
limitations: Disputes are decided by Meta under its own evidence rules
Outcomes depend on the evidence available and on the other party's position
I cannot compel another person to hand over access

meta.title: Admin Dispute Resolution | Atikul Islam Rabbi
meta.description: Help resolving disputes over Page and Business Manager admin access. Evidence review and Meta's dispute channels. No guaranteed outcomes.

services.title: Security Consultation
services.cardSummary: Reviewing how your accounts are set up and advising on the gaps most likely to lead to a compromise.
services.summary: Advising businesses and creators on strengthening the security of their social media accounts and Business Manager setup.
services.problem: Many account compromises are preventable. Weak admin structures, missing two-factor authentication, and unclear asset ownership all increase risk.
services.approach: I review the current security setup of your accounts and Business Manager, identify the gaps most likely to lead to a compromise, and recommend practical steps to close them.
whoFor: Creators and businesses that want to reduce risk before an incident
Teams that have grown and are not sure who has access to what
Organizations that recently had an incident and want to harden the setup

process.title: Tell me your goals
process.text: Describe the accounts in scope, who uses them, and what worries you most.

process.title: I review the setup
process.text: I review admin roles, two-factor settings, recovery contacts, and connected apps that you share with me.

process.title: You get prioritized actions
process.text: You receive the gaps ranked by risk, with the steps to close each one.

process.title: We follow up if needed
process.text: If you want help implementing the changes, we agree on that scope separately.

send: The accounts and assets in scope
Who currently has access, and at what role
Any recent incidents or suspicious activity
limitations: Consultation does not fix an active compromise. That falls under the relevant recovery service
Recommendations are only as complete as the information you share
Platform settings change over time, so advice reflects the date of review

meta.title: Security Consultation | Atikul Islam Rabbi
meta.description: Security consultation for social media accounts and Meta Business Manager setups: access, two-factor settings, and prioritized fixes. Remote, worldwide.

services.title: Social Media Security Audit
services.cardSummary: A structured review of administrator access, asset ownership, and account settings, with a prioritized fix list.
services.summary: A structured review of your social media and Business Manager accounts to identify security risks before they become incidents.
services.problem: Businesses often lack a clear view of who has access to their Pages, ad accounts, and Business Manager, or of which settings leave them exposed.
services.approach: I review administrator access, asset ownership, and account-level security settings across your Facebook, Instagram, and Business Manager presence, then provide a clear summary of findings and recommendations.
whoFor: Businesses with several admins, Pages, and ad accounts
Agencies that manage assets for clients
Teams preparing for growth, a handover, or a change of staff

process.title: Define the scope
process.text: We agree which Pages, ad accounts, Business Managers, and Instagram accounts are in scope.

process.title: Review access and settings
process.text: I review admin and editor roles, asset ownership, and security settings for each asset.

process.title: You get a prioritized report
process.text: You receive the findings ranked by risk, with the fix for each one.

process.title: Optional follow-up
process.text: If you want help making the changes, we agree on that scope separately.

send: A list of Pages, ad accounts, Business Managers, and Instagram accounts
The current admin and editor list, by asset
Any known issues or concerns
limitations: An audit identifies risks and fixes. It does not recover accounts
Findings reflect what was reviewed on the date of the audit
Some checks depend on the access level you can share

meta.title: Social Media Security Audit | Atikul Islam Rabbi
meta.description: A structured security audit of Facebook, Instagram, and Meta Business Manager access, with a prioritized report. Preventive review, not account recovery.
